text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Alright! I hereby declare:
I will take 1st place in this race without fail!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Of course I want to avenge my loss,
but it's not just that—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
There's the effort I've poured in for this day,
and the undeniable fact that you, Trainer, supported me through it all.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: So I'm fine, I can definitely do this!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yeah, watch me from the best seat in the house!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna show you everything
I've gained from my training!
